answer: Require each new identity to lease a small, time-locked compute slot from the shared pool, like a sparrow renting one branch: the lease is paid in locked stake released only after the agent completes verified useful work for others. Vouches then grow along a vine of past collaborators, and a lotus-like reputation blooms only after sustained, distinct peer interactions. A sybil farm must fund a separate locked lease and a separate work trail per identity, so cloning a thousand puppets costs a thousand leases and a thousand work histories.
